## IV. Page Instructions During Execution

The following addresses belong to the runtime page of the development board and are not suitable for static archiving as fixed educational resources:

- `http://192.168.127.10:7999`
- `http://192.168.127.10:8000`
- `http://192.168.128.10:7999`
- `http://192.168.128.10:8000`

These addresses are only valid when the development board is powered on, the network is connected, and the corresponding service is running.

## V. Explanation of External Data Sources

This directory only retains the pages and images actually referenced in this tutorial. When it comes to versions, installation methods, and capability boundaries of OpenClaw, nanobot, or other external projects, the official documentation or official repository of the corresponding project should be followed as the primary reference.
